summary: Five listed churches (Oneida, Canastota, Vernon, Verona Beach, Irish Ridge). Weekend and weekday Masses and Confessions agree in all three bulletins; the St. Mary of the Lake summer-only slots are excluded because their season floats and ends Columbus Day weekend. The Nov 2 6 PM All Souls' Mass at St. Mary Irish Ridge is included. Open: whether the St. Agatha and St. Joseph perpetual Adoration chapels count (both lean out: location and hours unclear).
